output:
To: rhonda@lindenpikediner.example
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: drivers christmas breakfast Dec 19

Hi Rhonda its Gary from the bus garage again. I'd like to get our drivers christmas breakfast set up at your place like we do every year. We're hoping for Saturday Dec 19 in the back room at 7am, same as always. If the 19th is no good for you, Saturday Dec 12 would work for us, so just let me know which one you can do.

Dwayne gave me the signup sheet off the board in the drivers room. Right now its 19 drivers, 3 from the shop, and Earl and Carol, so 24 counting the two of them. I know that's not the final number yet. If we do the 19th, I'll get you one final count by Wednesday Dec 16 like you asked last year. If we end up on the 12th, I'll have it to you by Wednesday Dec 9.

Now the part I need kept quiet. Earl is retiring after 31 years of driving, and his last day is Dec 18, so if the 19th works the breakfast will be the morning after. He don't know we're planning anything and we want to keep it that way. If you see him in the diner before then, please don't let on. Carol says a big speech would just embarrass him, but we'd like to do a little something for him with everybody there.

That's where I need your opinion. Your cinnamon rolls are better than any cake anyway and Earl loves them. Would you rather we bring in a cake from Sugarcreek, or could you do a big tray of your cinnamon rolls with a candle in it? I checked with Sugarcreek already and a half sheet serves about 30. Its $48 plain or $56 with writing and a little bus on top, and they need five days notice. They open at 6am Saturdays so somebody could pick it up before breakfast. If you'd rather not have an outside cake brought in, that's fine, the cinnamon rolls would suit me better anyway. Just tell me which is easier for you and what I owe you.

For breakfast, does the same family style setup work again, with eggs, home fries and biscuits and gravy, and everybody ordering their own meat off the menu? The $11 a head last year seemed fair to everybody, and its fine if its gone up a little. Just let me know the price so I can tell the guys. Separate checks again too please, since that worked out fine last time.

One food thing, Patsy can't do eggs anymore. Could she get oatmeal or pancakes or whatever you've got that she can eat? It don't have to be anything fancy, just something so she's not sitting there with coffee while everybody else eats.

Also Lonnie is on a walker now since his hip. Can we plan on bringing him in through your side door where there's no steps? Will that door be open that early, or should I let you know when we get there so you can get him in?

And about the coffee, I know you felt bad when it ran out about 8:15 last year but that urn quitting wasn't your fault. Could we just make sure there's a backup pot or urn ready this time? With 24 of us I'd hate to run short again, and you mentioned having a backup next time so I figured I'd ask ahead.

Thanks Rhonda. Once I know which date works and what you want to do about the cake or rolls, I'll get the rest lined up and won't say a word to Earl.

Gary
